meta.name: Singles Inferno
meta.description: On a deserted island, flirtatious singles look for love, because only as a couple can they leave the island for a romantic date in paradise.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Single contestants arrive on the island, where they're introduced to potential friends, lovers and foes they'll be living with for the next eight days.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The men race to win a brunch date. Matched couples leave for their first night in Paradise, and reveal their age and jobs to one another.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Se-hoon pulls Ji-yeon aside for a chat before the second couple selection. A surprise announcement throws the singles a curveball.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A mesmerizing night in Paradise changes the game for Si-hun. Confused by Jin-taek's actions, So-yeon has a candid talk with Se-hoon.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Se-hoon responds to So-yeon's previous advice and confession. Newcomers enter the island, shaking up the game and bringing trouble to paradise.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The men try to push each other out of the game. The women take turns chatting up Hyun-seung. Se-hoon contemplates following his heart.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ji-yeon and Se-hoon clear up misunderstandings. So-yeon and Jin-taek grow closer. In pairs, the singles compete in one final game for Paradise.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: On the final day, singles choose the person they want to leave Inferno with. How many couples will depart the island hand-in-hand?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A new group of single men and women arrives at the Inferno, where they make their first impressions and find opportunities to connect while settling in.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The women play a game where the winner gets to go on a brunch date with two men of her choice. The first round of matching takes a shocking turn.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Matched couples finally learn each others' age and profession. Back at the Inferno, disappointed singles take time to reflect on the events of the day.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A charismatic newcomer captures Shin Seul-ki's attention. For the second couple selection, some follow their heart while others seek someone new.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In Paradise, one couple enjoys time at a theme park while another finds surprising common ground. A third couple develops some romantic chemistry.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Jo Yoong-jae and Choi Seo-eun touch base after a night apart. Choi Jong-woo expresses his true feelings. New arrivals shake up the dynamic of the group.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The newcomers pick their dates. Kim Jin-young's growing popularity gives Jong-woo a chance. The ladies wrestle for one of three tickets to Paradise.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Upon having honest discussions with their peers, Lee So-e comes to a thoughtful understanding of herself while Seul-ki becomes further conflicted.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: After an intense game, three men claim their ticket to Paradise. Jin-young tries to reconnect with Seul-ki, who wonders what his true feelings are.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As their time at the Inferno comes to a close, singles decide who they'd like to leave the island with. Could this be the start of new love?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Three men and three women looking for love arrive at the island — with an immediate chance to depart for Paradise. But a wild twist awaits the couples.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Fresh new singles enter the game and stir the pot. A pair escapes to Paradise, but will their bond withstand what fate has in store for them?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After a nerve-racking couple matching, a Paradise trip sparks fresh chemistry — particularly for one flirty couple who can't get enough of each other.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The two Infernos merge. Will more options test seemingly-solid relationships? Tension brews after a candidly honest conversation between the singles.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A hot newcomer lands on the island, shaking up a once stoic single. Ha-jeong is riled up after Gwan-hee's jaw-dropping confession the previous night.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The women compete in a game for a chance at Paradise with the man of their choosing. Lee Jin-seok finds himself caught in a love triangle.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Facing many confessions, Gwan-hee must contemplate his options. Choi Min-woo slowly opens up. The remaining men compete in a race for a date in Paradise.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As three couples relish Paradise, two women question Gwan-hee's affections. Later, a chicken fight determines their chance to win a date in Paradise.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Distraught over the "Lee Gwan-hee Derby" result, a contestant breaks down before her date. Yu Si-eun and Min-woo attempt to reclaim lost time.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Gyu-ri’s attitude changes after a startling confession. On his long-awaited date, Yoon Ha-bin goes awfully silent. Gwan-hee struggles to make up his mind.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: As the final days loom, contestants grapple with tangled emotions. But the ultimate question remains: Who will couple up and exit the island together?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hot singles arrive on Inferno in search of love. Within just 10 minutes, two couples are already heading to Paradise — how did things heat up so fast?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It's love at first sight for one single, only to have her heart shaken by a man with unpredictable charms. Meanwhile, new connections start to form.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Couples return from their retreat to Paradise, creating tension in those already with attachments. After, the women compete for an exclusive date.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The campfire hangout turns into a whirlwind of confessions and provocations, especially for two singles. After the chaos, a surprise awaits the women.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The women go on one-on-one speed dates, giving a new man a chance to be a contestant. Back in Inferno, the men meet an attractive new arrival.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Lee Si-an struggles with conflicting feelings as she feels pulled between multiple men. The arrival of a new woman throws the group dynamic into flux.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Three couples head to Paradise, deepening bonds and uncovering secrets. Meanwhile, Si-an struggles with indecision, feeling her heart's uncertainty.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The men duke it out in a wrestling match that'll send them to Paradise. But before they go, some singles jump at the chance to define where they stand.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Unforeseen picks send three couples to Paradise, where a sudden double date sways one single’s feelings, while inconsiderate behavior puts off another.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Emotions shift after couples return from Paradise — so when an aquatic tussle awards three women another trip, it sparks an intense and fiery debate.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: While one single tries to be frank to avoid being chosen for the final Paradise trip, Si-an finds herself increasingly uncertain about her own feelings.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The final days in Inferno are here — and the singles make their last attempts at sealing romance. Who will leave as a couple, and who will be left behind?

meta.slogan: A romantic and exciting dating reality show that follows 10 men and women trapped on a hot deserted island.
